clean_repro.probe: POST /v2/vectordb/entities/upsert with JSON field containing plain string 'invalid_json'
clean_repro.observed: API returns HTTP 200 with upsertCount=1, accepting invalid JSON string without validation

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: Upsert HTTP handler → checkAndSetData → case DataType_JSON → direct byte assignment without json.Unmarshal validation
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:JSON字段处理(case DataType_JSON)直接将dataString转为[]byte,未进行json.Unmarshal验证。与向量字段(FloatVector等)形成鲜明对比,后者都会json.Unmarshal并检查错误。这是真缺陷 - 缺少JSON格式校验

falsification.probe: Query the upserted entity to verify the invalid JSON was stored
falsification.observed: Query fails with 'collection not loaded' error, but the upsert already succeeded with HTTP 200, proving the invalid JSON was accepted without validation

cognition_match.developer_quote: REST v2 API data type serialization - 8 issues in corpus
cognition_match.note: 命中开发者认知盲点:REST v2 API数据类型序列化问题频发。JSON字段缺少校验正是此类问题的典型表现

verdicts.rationale: 实际复现成功:HTTP 200接受plain string 'invalid_json'作为JSON字段值。源码接地证实:utils.go:760-761处JSON字段直接赋值[]byte(dataString),未进行json.Unmarshal验证,与向量字段处理形成对比(后者都验证)。契约对照:DataType_JSON要求JSON数据类型。这是真正的数据校验缺失缺陷,属于REST v2 API数据类型序列化问题的已知盲点模式
